$comment: The source of sf-tooltip's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/tooltip (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

appearance.summary: How the tooltip looks: dark is the inverse surface (the plain tooltip, the default), light a raised surface.

size.summary: Framework typography and spacing scale; 1/3, the default, is the plain tooltip: the small text step, regular, 4 x 8.

shortcut.summary: The trigger's key combination (mod+b, shift+/), drawn after the text as quiet keys by the kbd component.

relations.name: kbd
$comment: The shortcut is the kbd component's keys: plain and quiet in a tooltip (C04).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-tooltip for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20).

rows.summary: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

x-summary: Tooltip surface that can join the ordinary data-tooltip trigger composition.
x-renamed: settings.type → appearance: the axis's old name (contracts/public-api-axes.json), alias dated
x-decisions: a11y-role: tooltip, one role; the name is the text (the setting, or the text slot). The data-tooltip controller of the class component links a trigger to it with aria-describedby.
a11y-name: from text, then slot:text (the old shape "internal" said the same).

layer: none. sf-tooltip is the tooltip's look, drawn where it stands; it neither opens nor closes and takes no keys. The tooltip that floats over the page is the class controller's ([data-tooltip], component/tooltip/js/_tooltip.js), a layer for its own migration.
version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: type is a dated alias of appearance.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; the slots content, text, supporting-text and tail are the page's nodes, placed.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus the dark look, an arrow and supporting text; probe.json reads the drawn markup.
css-variables: the eight public variables the sheet already reads (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

version 1.1.1: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (2026-11-09): a minor (owner 2026-11-09: tooltips were heavy and coarse; DEV measured 14/20 at 700 with padding 6 x 14 on a compact page, Material 3 plain is 12/16 at 400 with 4 x 8). The defaults are the plain tooltip: size 1/3 (the small text step, 12/16 on desktop) and appearance dark, now the inverse-surface role (--sf-surface-inverse and --sf-on-surface-inverse, which turn light in a dark theme; it was the fixed dark surface). The text is regular; a rich tooltip (text with supporting-text) keeps its first line bold as its title. Size 1/3 pads 4 x 8 (--sf-space-1/4 by --sf-space-1/3; it was the size ladder's 4 x 12), radius --sf-radius--ui (--sf-radius-1/2, 4). New: shortcut (mod+b, shift+/) and the shortcut slot, drawn after the text as the kbd component's keys, plain and quiet in a tooltip (C04). A page that wants the former look sets size="1" and appearance="light". The sheet is component.tooltip 1.1.0; the data-tooltip controller there opens on hover and keyboard focus (:focus-visible) only and hides when the trigger is pressed.

version 1.2.1 (2026-11-13, C59 tooltip kind, owner decision 2026-11-11): a patch; nothing this element draws or reads changed. Its examples and docs follow C59: no arrow in the studio fixture (arrow none is the default), the shortcut written with shortcut (the kbd component's keys) and never as plain text in supporting-text. Its sheet is component.tooltip 1.3.1: the light look has no frame and its shadow, drawn as --sf-shadow-overlay-filter over the surface and the tail together, is the window's; a tail carries the same shadow. Linked by data-tooltip, the controller there opens it after 0.5 s of hover, its neighbours at once (while one shows and 0.3 s after), at once on keyboard focus, and by a long press on a touch screen (shown while held and 1.5 s after).

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-tooltip for a short non-interactive description. Link it to a native trigger with the ordinary data-tooltip composition when Framework should own hover, focus and Escape behavior.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not place links, buttons or fields inside a tooltip
Do not use aria-expanded or aria-haspopup for tooltip visibility

keyboard: Escape dismisses a linked open tooltip without moving trigger focus
accessibility.focus: The surface never receives focus. A linked native trigger owns focus and aria-describedby.

root-class.description: Framework utility classes for the visible surface root.
